requirements.description: User prefers properties near healthcare services. Value set to the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution.
User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes all classes from A1 to D.
The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 360 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 360 sqm), a 3.0 km haversine radius around the Location Agent's coordinates, energy_class D or better (A1-A4, B, C, D), and healthcare proximity score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the supplied coordinates. Office-type and 18-person capacity were not in the extracted requirements, so no predicates were added for them.
